## Helios Solar — enquiry qualification
1. Set the Supabase URL in Configuration.
2. For Claim and Finish, select an HTTP Custom Auth credential with apikey + Authorization headers (see README).
3. Select an OpenAI credential on Generate brief. Model must support Responses structured outputs.
4. Apply the Supabase migration first, test manually, then activate.
One job per minute; atomic leases expire after 10 minutes. Max 3 attempts with 5-minute retry delay. No customer messages are sent. Execution payload persistence is disabled; protect manual runs.
